
```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import quantities as pq
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
from quantities import s
from neo.core import SpikeTrain, Segment, Event, Block
from elephant.conversion import BinnedSpikeTrain
from elephant.spike_train_generation import StationaryPoissonProcess
from elephant.spike_train_correlation import cross_correlation_histogram
from viziphant.spike_train_correlation import plot_cross_correlation_histogram
root = Path.cwd().parent.absolute()
np.random.seed(1)
%matplotlib inline
```

First, test the method on simulated data.

```{python}
rate = 10. * pq.Hz 
t_start = 0 * pq.ms
t_stop = 5000 * pq.ms
```
Case 1: The neurons spike synchronously
```{python}
spikes_i = StationaryPoissonProcess( rate, t_start, t_stop).generate_spiketrain()
spikes_j = StationaryPoissonProcess( rate, t_start, t_stop).generate_spiketrain()
bst_i = BinnedSpikeTrain(spikes_i, bin_size=5*pq.ms)
bst_j = BinnedSpikeTrain(spikes_j, bin_size=5*pq.ms)
cc_hist, lags = cross_correlation_histogram( bst_i, bst_j, window=[-20, 20])
plot_cross_correlation_histogram(cc_hist)
```

Case 2: The neurons fire synchronously
```{python}
spikes_j = SpikeTrain(
    times=spikes_i.times+np.random.normal(loc=0, scale=5, size=len(spikes_i))*pq.ms, t_start=t_start, t_stop=t_stop
)
bst_i = BinnedSpikeTrain(spikes_i, bin_size=5*pq.ms)
bst_j = BinnedSpikeTrain(spikes_j, bin_size=5*pq.ms)
cc_hist, lags = cross_correlation_histogram( bst_i, bst_j, window=[-20, 20])
plot_cross_correlation_histogram(cc_hist)
```

Case 3: The neurons fire with a constant delay
```{python}
spikes_j = SpikeTrain(
    times=spikes_i.times+np.random.normal(loc=30, scale=5, size=len(spikes_i))*pq.ms, t_start=t_start, t_stop=t_stop
)
bst_i = BinnedSpikeTrain(spikes_i, bin_size=5*pq.ms)
bst_j = BinnedSpikeTrain(spikes_j, bin_size=5*pq.ms)
cc_hist, lags = cross_correlation_histogram( bst_i, bst_j, window=[-20, 20])
plot_cross_correlation_histogram(cc_hist)
```


Now load the real data
```{python}
sessions = list((root/"data").glob("ses*"))
ses = sessions[0]
spikes = pd.read_parquet(ses/"spikes.parquet")
stimuli = pd.read_parquet(ses/"stimuli.parquet")
n_stimuli = len(stimuli['start_time'])
```
Create a neo segment and add the unit spike trains
```{python}
t_start = stimuli["start_time"].min()-1
t_stop = stimuli["start_time"].max()+1
seg = Segment()
for unit_id in spikes["unit_id"].unique():
    spikes_unit = spikes[spikes["unit_id"]==unit_id]
    spike_train = SpikeTrain(spikes_unit['spike_time'],units="s", t_stop=t_stop, t_start=t_start, name=f"{unit_id}-unit_id")
    seg.spiketrains.append(spike_train)
```

Example 1: two neurons that fire in a coordinated way
```{python}
bst_i = BinnedSpikeTrain(seg.spiketrains[10], bin_size=0.01*s)
bst_j = BinnedSpikeTrain(seg.spiketrains[200], bin_size=0.01*s)
cc_hist, lags = cross_correlation_histogram( bst_i, bst_j, window=[-20, 20], border_correction=False, binary=False, kernel=None)
plot_cross_correlation_histogram(cc_hist)
```

Example 2: Two neurons that are not associated
```{python}
bst_i = BinnedSpikeTrain(seg.spiketrains[0], bin_size=0.01*s)
bst_j = BinnedSpikeTrain(seg.spiketrains[2], bin_size=0.01*s)
cc_hist, lags = cross_correlation_histogram( bst_i, bst_j, window=[-20, 20], border_correction=False, binary=False, kernel=None)
plot_cross_correlation_histogram(cc_hist)
```
